name: Realtor.com
description: Realtor.com is a residential real-estate marketplace for home and rental search, property information, agent discovery, housing research, and professional marketing products. Consumers and real-estate professionals use its web and mobile experiences to research markets and collaborate around listings.
agentUseSummary: Realtor.com cannot currently be connected through Relay. Move does not publish a distributable customer-account API or delegated OAuth contract, and its current terms restrict the service to personal, non-commercial use unless expressly permitted, prohibit automated collection and private-area access, and expressly prohibit using its content for machine-learning or generative-AI systems. Downloadable Economic Research files and Realtor.com+ are separate products, not general agent API authority.

blocked.label: Connect a Realtor.com account
blocked.description: Realtor.com does not publish a supported third-party customer-account API, OAuth application contract, token lifecycle, scopes, or revocation interface for Relay.

blocked.label: Read Realtor.com property or account data
blocked.description: Listings, searches, saves, shares, messages, tours, My Home data, professional clients, leads, advertising data, and private account content are unavailable to Relay.

blocked.label: Perform Realtor.com professional actions
blocked.description: Contacting agents or clients, requesting tours, managing leads or advertising, changing listings, collaborating in Realtor.com+, and mortgage or transaction actions are blocked.

blocked.label: Automate or use Realtor.com content with agents
blocked.description: Scraping, automated collection, text or data mining, private interfaces, browser automation, credential capture, bulk extraction, and using content to ground or operate generative-AI systems are blocked.

blocked.label: Automate Realtor.com research downloads
blocked.description: Economic Research downloads remain attribution-bound published files; Relay does not infer a stable automation API, account authority, or permission for agent ingestion or redistribution.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Realtor.com action is enabled without an exact written and distributable API and AI-use contract, source and MLS permissions, and acceptance for the intended product, fields, geography, audience, attribution, display, retention, redistribution, and downstream use.

runtimeSupport.description: Realtor.com publishes no supported agent API contract, and its current terms prohibit generative-AI use of Move Network content.
Realtor.com publishes no supported agent API contract, and its current terms prohibit generative-AI use of Move Network content.

providerSetup.blocker: Move publishes consumer Realtor.com, Realtor.com+, professional marketing and lead products, and downloadable Economic Research data, but no distributable customer-account API, delegated OAuth contract, scopes, token lifecycle, webhooks, or supported agent runtime. Current terms require express written permission for scraping, automated collection and access to non-public areas; restrict content to personal, non-commercial use; and expressly prohibit using content for machine learning, LLM grounding, or generative-AI systems.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Realtor.com credentials or show Connect. Reconsider only after Move grants Relay an exact written API and agent-use contract for one bounded product. Product, legal, data-governance, fair-housing, privacy, security, and source owners must then freeze MLS rights, fields, geography, user and professional roles, attribution, display, freshness, retention, redistribution, model-use limits, rate, audit, deletion, and termination rules before implementation.

evidence.supports: Move limits the network to personal non-commercial use unless otherwise specified, requires express written permission for scraping or automated collection and non-public access, and prohibits using content for machine learning, LLM grounding, or generative-AI systems.
Move documents consumer and professional account data, saved and collaborative experiences, lead and advertising relationships, and distinct privacy treatment for Realtor.com+ Connected Clients.
Realtor.com Economic Research publishes downloadable aggregate housing inventory and market-hotness files with attribution and data-library linking requirements.
Realtor.com+ is a protected MLS-powered collaboration product for eligible professionals and connected clients, not a public third-party application API.
Realtor.com PRO is a portfolio of professional lead-generation, advertising, training, and growth products rather than a generic consumer account integration contract.
